name: Silk Reference Tools
description: Centers or places, hides/shows, and resizes footprint silkscreen reference designators — one dialog, one undo step. KiCad 9 & 10 (IPC API).
description_full:
KiCad 9.0 / 10.0 IPC API plugin with one action and one settings dialog. Every checked operation is applied in a single undo step.

- Scope: all footprints, selected only, or footprints matching a reference designator, value or library ID (* and ? wildcards; prefilled from the selection).
- Reference position: move the reference to its courtyard centroid or just outside it (auto, above, below, left or right). Side filter (front/back/both), rotation control (match footprint, 0° or keep), auto scale-down to fit the courtyard, pad-collision nudging, optional CSV of skipped footprints.
- Silkscreen: show or hide reference text in bulk; adjust its size in 0.05 mm steps (0.1–3.0 mm).
- Theme: System / Light / Dark (KiCad 10).

Requires Preferences → Plugins → Enable KiCad API. Version 1.0.0 is the legacy SWIG plugin for KiCad 9.0 without the API enabled; SWIG plugins stop working in KiCad 11.0.
